comment: RE-REVIEW 2026-10-22 item A (reviewer repro sfm2): two Stoneforge Mystics in hand, the line 'cast both' validated WITH its "**" sequence. The step matcher treated two hand copies whose plans differ only in a sub-decision (which Equipment each one fetches) as 'different plays' and refused them, so the natural 'Jitte + Bonesplitter' variant silently vanished from the choose dialog (3 -> 2), and where only such variants existed the line was Illegal ('queue it from the exact permanent' -- impossible for a hand card). Hand copies of one card are interchangeable for matching; the fetches are the chosen variant's. All 3 variants stay.
